title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures waver amid continued Iran fallout, with CPI on deck
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货因伊朗局势持续波动而消费者物价指数 (CPI) 上升
summary: Wall Street continues to be buffeted by the winds of war, as the effects of the Iran war are being seen through widespread volatility.
summary_zh: 华尔街继续受到战争之风的打击，伊朗战争的影响正在通过广泛的波动显现出来。

title: Wall St closes mixed on ramped-up Middle East tensions
title_zh: 中东紧张局势加剧，华尔街收盘涨跌互现

title: Microsoft backs Anthropic in amicus brief to halt US DOD's 'supply-chain risk' designation
title_zh: 微软在法庭之友陈述中支持 Anthropic，以停止美国国防部的“供应链风险”认定
summary: Microsoft filed on Tuesday a brief in support of Anthropic's lawsuit asking the court to temporarily block the U.S. Department of Defense's ‌designation of the AI startup as a supply-chain risk.
summary_zh: 微软周二提交了一份简报，支持 Anthropic 的诉讼，要求法院暂时阻止美国国防部将这家人工智能初创公司指定为供应链风险。

title: Oracle sees AI boom through at least 2027, sending shares up 8%
title_zh: 甲骨文预计人工智能至少会在 2027 年蓬勃发展，股价上涨 8%
summary: Oracle on Tuesday predicted that the AI data center boom will power its revenue above Wall Street estimates well into 2027, sending its shares up 8.3% in extended trading.
summary_zh: 甲骨文周二预测，人工智能数据中心的繁荣将使其收入在 2027 年远超华尔街预期，推动其股价在盘后交易中上涨 8.3%。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 end lower, oil slides as Wall Street weighs Iran war signals
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标准普尔 500 指数收低，华尔街衡量伊朗战争信号，油价下跌
summary: Wall Street is adjusting to a historic spike and fall in oil prices after the global economy was thrown into disarray.
summary_zh: 全球经济陷入混乱后，华尔街正在适应油价历史性的上涨和下跌。

title: Former energy secretary Rick Perry says AI revolution hinges on 2 limitations
title_zh: 前能源部长里克·佩里表示人工智能革命取决于两个限制
summary: The former Texas governor believes the AI race will be won by energy-rich states and companies that can navigate a tightening industrial supply chain.
summary_zh: 这位前德克萨斯州州长认为，能源丰富的州和能够应对日益紧张的工业供应链的公司将赢得人工智能竞赛。

title: Tech stocks today: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang blogs about AI's impact, Anthropic sues Defense Department over ban
title_zh: 今日科技股：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在博客中谈论人工智能的影响，Anthropic 就禁令起诉国防部
summary: Artificial intelligence continues to make waves in markets, spurring new investments and concerns each week.
summary_zh: 人工智能继续在市场上掀起波澜，每周都会引发新的投资和担忧。

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang: AI will be 'foundational infrastructure'
title_zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋：人工智能将成为“基础设施”
summary: Ahead of Nvidia's (NVDA) annual GTC developer conference starts next week, CEO Jensen Huang wrote a blog post about artificial intelligence (AI) as the infrastructure of the future.
summary_zh: 在 Nvidia (NVDA) 年度 GTC 开发者大会下周开始之前，首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 撰写了一篇关于人工智能 (AI) 作为未来基础设施的博文。
